# Hi, I'm Jonathan

I build **intelligent systems** for the messy seam between the physical and digital worlds — predictive platforms, decision intelligence, and digital twins for safety- and mission-critical infrastructure.

Systems & software engineer working across data platforms, AI/ML, and cyber-physical intelligence.

:::

---

## What I'm Doing Now

Working as a **systems engineer building data pipelines, warehouse, and ecosystem purpose-built for AI/ML workflows** — the kind of foundation that turns raw operational signals into something models, agents, and humans can actually reason over.

---

## Currently Building: AeroFlux

**[AeroFlux](projects/ai-ml/aero-flux.html)** is a predictive intelligence platform for U.S. domestic flight delays — and the seed of a broader **cyber-physical intelligence layer** for networks of interdependent agents moving through shared physical space.

---

## Also In Motion

Home robotics, 3D printing, agentic AI experiments at the edge, and early prototypes around decision intelligence for operational environments. The through-line is the same: **systems that perceive state, anticipate consequences, and help humans act before the window closes.**
